title: Ajiye shi bushe, mai tsabta kuma a rufe, sannan tabbatar da yana aiki
course_title: Gudanar da Bayan Girbin Girbin da Kula da Abinci

say: Ajiye shi bushe, mai tsabta kuma a rufe, sannan tabbatar da yana aiki.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 2 na Gudanar da Girbi Bayan Girbi da Tsarewar Abinci.
Don hatsi da legumes, dokoki guda uku suna kare kusan komai. Ajiye shi bushe, adana shi da tsabta, adana shi a rufe. Kowace doka ta toshe ɗayan abubuwan da ke haifar da asara daga Module 1.

panel.heading: Abin da ke kare hatsi da legumes
items: Ajiye shi bushe: damp hatsi girma m
Ajiye shi mai tsabta: kwari suna farawa a cikin datti da fashewar hatsi
Ajiye shi a rufe: babu iska don kwari, babu hanyar shiga don beraye
Sa'an nan kuma auna don tabbatar da cewa yana aiki

say: Sannan ku duba kantin sayar da ku akai-akai, kuma ku sake aunawa daidai da hanyar, don haka lambobin ku suna nuna ko canjin ya biya.

say: Hatsi na iya jin bushewa a waje yayin da cikin yake da ɗanɗano. Idan ba ku da mitar danshi, yi amfani da gwajin tudun gishiri.
A busar da gishirin tebur akan ƙaramin wuta kuma bar shi yayi sanyi. Cika busasshiyar gilashin gilashi mai tsabta kamar kashi ɗaya bisa uku cike da hatsi daga samfurin gaskiya.

say: Sai a zuba cokali biyu ko uku na busasshen gishiri, a rufe murfi sosai, sannan a girgiza na tsawon minti biyu zuwa uku. Bar shi kamar minti goma sha biyar.

say: Idan gishiri ya manne a gilashin, hatsin har yanzu yana da ɗanɗano. Ka bushe shi kuma a sake gwadawa. Idan gishiri ya tsaya sako-sako, ya bushe sosai.
Koyaushe bushe a kan kwalta ko tabarma, ba a kan ƙasa maras komai ba.

panel.rule: Gishiri ya tsaya a gilashin? Danshi yayi yawa. Kara bushewa.

say: Hermetic yana nufin hana iska. An rufe shi, kwari suna amfani da iskar oxygen, dakatar da ciyarwa kuma su mutu. Ba a buƙatar maganin kwari. Amma da farko tsaftace hatsi da share kura ta kakar bara.

say: Bincika kowane layi akan hasken, kuma kada kuyi amfani da tsagege. Saka lilin a cikin jakar da aka saka kuma a cika da busasshiyar hatsi mai tsabta.

panel.rule: Kar a bude jakunkuna akai-akai. Ajiye ƙaramin kwano don amfanin yau da kullun.

say: Wuraren aminci guda uku. Allunan fumigation suna fitar da iskar gas mai guba sosai. Masu horarwa, masu fumigator masu lasisi kawai za su iya amfani da su, kuma ba inda mutane ke zaune ko barci ba.

cards.d: Gas phosphine na iya kashewa. Masu horarwa kawai, masu fumigator masu lasisi. Kada a cikin gida ko ɗakin kwana.
Kayayyakin da aka yi wa rajista na NAFDAC na hatsi da aka adana, ana amfani da su kamar yadda alamar ta ce. Kada a taɓa fesa filin.
Yi amfani da ruwa mai tsabta akan kayan lambu da masu sanyaya. Wanke hannu da tsabtace kwantena tsakanin amfani.

say: Idan kuna amfani da maganin kashe kwari, yi amfani da ɗaya kawai da Hukumar NAFDAC ta yi rajista don adana hatsi, kuma ku bi tambarin daidai. Kada a taɓa amfani da auduga ko feshin filin akan abinci. Hermetic ajiya yana guje wa wannan haɗarin.

say: Kuma ruwa mai datti yana yada ƙwayoyin cuta, ko da lokacin da samfurin ya yi kama da sabo. Yi amfani da ruwa mai tsafta, wanke hannuwanku, da tsaftataccen kwanduna tsakanin amfani.

say: Ba za a iya rufe sabbin kayan amfanin gona kamar hatsi ba. Kuna rage numfashi kuma kuna kare shi daga raunuka. A yi girbi da wuri, a yi masa inuwa da sauri, sannan a jera ɓangarorin da suka lalace, domin rubabben tumatur yana yada ruɓe ga maƙwabtansa.

say: Matsaloli suna farawa kaɗan. Kowane mako biyu, tafiya kantin sayar da. Nemo kwari, foda, droppings, jakunkuna da aka tauna da danshi. Kamshi ga mustiness.

panel.heading: Duba kantin sayar da ku akan aikin yau da kullun
items: Kowane mako biyu: duba da kamshi
Kowane wata: samfurin da ƙidaya-da-auna
Jakunkuna na Hermetic: bincika ramuka, kar a buɗe
Fresh kayan lambu da dawa: kowane 'yan kwanaki

say: Kowane wata, samfurin buɗaɗɗen jakunkuna tare da rajistan ƙidayar-da nauyi. Hatsi da ke jin dumi a ciki alama ce ta gargaɗi.

say: A bara, a cikin buhunan talakawa, Hauwa ta yi asarar kashi 7.5 cikin 100, kimanin kilogiram 75. A wannan shekara ta yi amfani da jakunkuna na hermetic kuma ta duba da wannan hanya bayan watanni biyar. Asarar ta kasance kashi 1.0, kusan kilogiram 10.

card.title: Hauwa ta tabbatar an biya buhunan

say: Don haka ta ajiye kilogiram 65. Akan Naira 1,500 akan kowace kg, wato Naira 97,500 kenan. Jakunkunan sun kai Naira 35,000.

card.title: Hauwa ta tabbatar an biya buhunan

say: Ribar da ta samu ya kai kimanin naira 62,500 a kakar farko. Kwatanta kamar haka: amfanin gona iri ɗaya, lokacin ajiya iri ɗaya, hanya iri ɗaya.

card.title: Hauwa ta tabbatar an biya buhunan

say: Don tunawa. Ajiye shi bushe, mai tsabta kuma a rufe. Gwada bushewa kafin adanawa. Bar fumigation ga masu fumigator masu lasisi.
Bincika akai-akai, kuma aiwatar da ribar gidan yanar gizon ku: ƙimar abincin da aka ajiye, ban da farashin canjin.

say: Yanzu yi gwajin gilashin gishiri da kuma shirya nau'i mai tsabta guda ɗaya. Gwada sauyi ɗaya ko sanyaya canji akan sabbin samfura, kuma saita masu tuni na waya don binciken ku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
